name: Arcada University of Applied Sciences
summary: Swedish-speaking applied-sciences university in Helsinki; three English bachelor's in IT, business and sustainable engineering, won on IB grades.

ib.text: Certificate-based selection on the UAS IB scoring table: at least 60 points to be considered. An IB taught in English proves your English.

dates.label: Passport or EU/EEA ID copy due, 15:00
Final IB grades due through IBIS, 15:00

programmes.name: Information Technology
programmes.ib: Maths at grade 2 in AA (SL or HL) or AI HL, or grade 4 in AI SL (Arcada's A/C rule on the UAS IB table); 12 places, 9 for matriculation/IB applicants.

programmes.name: Mechanical and Sustainable Engineering
programmes.ib: Maths at grade 2 in AA (SL or HL) or AI HL, or grade 4 in AI SL (Arcada's A/C rule on the UAS IB table); 8 places, 6 for matriculation/IB applicants.

notes: Intakes are tiny: 45 places across the three degrees, most of them reserved for matriculation and IB applicants.
If your IB grades miss the thresholds, a separate application (30 October 2026 to 19 April 2027) accepts SAT, ACT or the OMPT maths test instead.
Arcada's fourth English programme, Nursing TopUp, is only for nurses already qualified outside the EU/EEA.
